title: Instrumentation odd jam session notes - 2026-09-21
content:
Context: quick cross-subteam jam to surface weird telemetry gaps noticed in last canary. Wanted to keep this lightweight — a bunch of half-baked ideas, concrete next steps, and owners.

Attendees: Aisha (notes), Marco, Jessie, Daniel, Priya (joined 10:20), random drop-ins from infra channel.

Agenda (5–35min):
- surface recent anomalies (drop in event counts around 09/18–09/19)
- reconcile UI vs backend metrics (latency buckets mismatch)
- decide temporary mitigations for current canary rollout (feature gate / fallback)
- assign short-term actions, flag long-term follow-ups

Notes / Observations:
- Analytics spike -> missing events: Dashboard impressions for panel X dropped ~40% for sessions >120s starting 09/18 03:00 UTC. Not correlated with traffic drop (traffic steady).
- Jessie: frontend telemetry shows a higher rate of client-side dropped-beacon logs for long sessions; suspect batching flush bug when tab hidden.
- Marco: backend ingestion shows increased 429s from CDN edge->collector for same window; rate limiting config changed on 09/17 (infra rollback on 09/20).
- Daniel: rollout changed the panel gating logic on 09/16 (A/B group assignment tweak). Could be correlated — experiment skewed toward long-running sessions.
- Found discrepancy: UI counter (client-reported impressions) and server dedup counter differ by ~8% in steady state; during anomaly period the gap widened to ~42%.
- Most missing events are final-summary events (end-of-session metrics) — suggests they fail to flush on unload or are throttled at collector.

Hypotheses (ranked quick):
1) Client flush logic regression for long sessions when visibilitychange event fires (recent PR touched batching) — HIGH
2) Collector rate-limiting at CDN resulted in soft-dropping of larger batched payloads — MED
3) Experiment assignment changed when session storage key schema changed, causing some clients to skip impression logging path — LOW
4) Telemetry ingestion pipeline backpressure misrouting due to recent sharding config — MED

Immediate mitigations agreed (temporary):
- Gate the new batching code for canary cohort B via runtime flag (disable aggressive batching) — owner: Jessie; due: 2026-09-22 EOD; Jira: ENG-2143.
- Re-enable collector soft-retries at edge for batched payloads (undo recent aggressive rate limit) — owner: Marco infra; due: 2026-09-22 noon; Jira: CON-982.
- Add a short-term synthetic heartbeat to the panel summary path for long sessions (fires every 60s) so we can observe whether events reach backend before unload — owner: Daniel; experimental; due: 2026-09-23.

Data & debug tasks (who / how):
- Pull raw CDN logs for 09/17–09/20, correlate by client-id/session-id -> Marco (have creds, will export to S3) — target: 2026-09-22 morning.
- Add temporary debug flag to client that increases logging verbosity for cohort B (only dev builds) -> Jessie + QA -> capture via staging for 24h.
- Run a quick A/B repro harness with headless chrome simulating 5–20 min sessions to reproduce flush behavior -> Daniel to script, use ci-job repro-telemetry-flush-09 -> due: 2026-09-23.

Longer-term action items / follow-ups (not blocking rollout but important):
- Review batching heuristics and boundary conditions: add unit tests around visibilitychange/unload handlers and ensure navigator.sendBeacon fallback is tested in headless environment. Owner: Jessie + DX; due: 2026-10-01.
- Telemetry contract doc: define expected 1:1 mapping guarantees between client impression and dedup keys; small confluence doc to be authored. Owner: Aisha; due: 2026-09-29.
- Reconcile and standardize latency bucket definitions between UI and backend (some buckets edge-case inclusive/exclusive mismatch). Owner: Marco + Analytics team; kickoff doc: CONSOLE-telemetry-buckets; due: 2026-10-06.

Rollout decision / status:
- Canary paused for cohort B while mitigations roll out. Cohort A stays live.
- No SLA impact currently but if missing-summary events persist product dashboards will be noisy — escalate if >48h.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Are there SPAs that never run visibilitychange reliably (iOS webviews)? Need to inventory. -> Priya to check mobile-web channel.
- Do we have any upstream CDN config changes scheduled this week (beyond rollback)? Marco to confirm with infra on planned changes.
- Is there a chance that deduping logic now mismatches a newly introduced client session id format? Daniel will examine PR history.

Quick links / snippets:
- Repro job skeleton: github.com/redwood-inference/console/tree/main/ci/repro/telemetry-flush (Daniel will push branch repro/flush-09 today)
- Recent PR to batching: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/738 (touched visibilitychange handler)
- Collector config diff: s3://infra-configs/collector-config-2026-09-17.diff

Meeting wrap / TL;DR:
- We saw a sharp gap in final-summary telemetry for long sessions after recent canary changes. Immediate plan: disable aggressive batching for canary B, add synthetic heartbeats, and re-enable collector soft-retries. Short repro and data pulls in flight. If mitigations fail within 48h we pause entire rollout.

Action items (summary table):
- ENG-2143: disable aggressive batching flag for cohort B — Jessie — due 2026-09-22 EOD.
- CON-982: rollback collector rate-limit tweak / add retries — Marco — due 2026-09-22 12:00.
- Repro harness + test runs — Daniel — due 2026-09-23.
- Inventory SPA/webview edge cases — Priya — due 2026-09-24.
- Telemetry contract doc — Aisha — due 2026-09-29.

Notes to self (loose):
- Keep notes here rather than sprint doc until we confirm root cause.
- Might need a quick postmortem if this affects customer dashboards >48h.

Next sync: ad-hoc tomorrow 09/22 11:00 UTC if data pulls show continued discrepancy; otherwise weekly standup follow-up 2026-09-24.

End of jam session notes.
